newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks fall in early trade, banks still weak.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks fall in early trade, banks still weak.

text.p: Tokyo stocks fell in early morning trade on Friday as sentiment was hurt by Wall Street's sharp drop overnight.
Bank shares remained weak after the previous day's sharp losses in the sector, also depressing the market, brokers said.
After 17 minutes of trade the 225-share Nikkei average had lost 115.61 points or 0.63 percent to 18,094.81. Its June futures were down 50 points at 18,140.
